title: publish_tips_after_post and TipAdvert are dead production code after gossipsub removal
description:
crates/reader/src/post/pipeline.rs contains publish_tips_after_post() and the TipAdvert struct. These are gossipsub propagation helpers. Commit bcd4026 ('refactor(transit): drop gossipsub and libp2p') removed gossipsub, but these were not cleaned up in the reader crate. The function is only called from within its own #[cfg(test)] module; there is no production call site. ServerStores has no gossip_tx field. The function, TipAdvert struct, and its three tests prove nothing about the current system.

Fix: delete publish_tips_after_post, TipAdvert, and their tests from pipeline.rs. If a future gossipsub replacement is added, this should be re-implemented from scratch rather than leaving stale code that implies gossipsub is active.
